evidence_items.locator: Section Resuming frontier training with stronger defenses
evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI confirms an actual suspension and resumption of frontier training workloads. This meets the development-slowdown reading, but does not establish a contraction in aggregate compute purchases or its financial consequences.

Reuters reports substantial market stress among AI infrastructure companies, while identifying higher interest-rate expectations and financing concerns. This is relevant evidence of strain, but it does not establish a financial crisis caused by the training slowdown.

evidence_items.locator: Section Heavy reliance on AI, Risk scenario
evidence_items.explanation: The IMF identifies a plausible financial risk from weaker AI investment and profitability. Its conditional assessment neither establishes an inevitable crisis nor documents one caused by the observed pause.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish how the training pause changed aggregate compute demand, purchases, or contractual commitments.
No cited record establishes serious technology-sector financial distress caused by the observed slowdown.
The evidence does not document a completed financial adjustment sufficient to establish a counterexample.
The claim provides no deadline for financial consequences.
